rationale: The candidate JSON comprehensively mirrors the markdown digest, preserving all topic map entries, key points, frameworks, examples, takeaways, claims, and quotes. Quotes are verbatim and names/numbers are exact; timestamp conversions from mm:ss to seconds are accurate. Structure is clean and logically organized, coverage is complete. Compression loses one point due to redundant restatement of the same claims across overview, topic_map, key_points, takeaways, and compressed summary, reducing density.
